answer: Public prompts get copied, so the nonce stays sealed. A joiner files one unsellable inbox on a compact atlas, bound to one payer, and escrows 2,480 POA idle 17 epochs. Each epoch two auditors from a cold tundra encrypt a 40-byte nonce to that inbox alone, a whisper no sibling can open, signed uniquely in 24s. Late, forwarded, or second-inbox replies burn 640 POA and bench it 16 epochs; a leaky auditor loses 220. Cost: 2,480 POA plus one decryptor; 650 clones need 1.612M POA and 650 openings in 24s, vs ~150 POA. Rented inboxes: two disjoint whispers plus two-hop or identical-signature slashes.
